# The FlexFlow

> Founder-led marketing engineering for high-growth businesses. Specializing in conversion-focused Web Design, AI Visibility (GEO/AEO), Search Engine Optimization, Performance Marketing Ads, Brand Systems, and Social Content Kits. Every client works directly with the founder doing the execution—no junior handoffs or account managers.

## Core Services

- [Web Design & Build](https://theflexflow.in/web-design): Custom sub-second websites built from Figma to production code in 4-week sprints.
- [AI Visibility (GEO/AEO)](https://theflexflow.in/ai-visibility): Entity graph mapping and brand citations so ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews cite and recommend your business.
- [Search Engine Optimization (SEO)](https://theflexflow.in/seo): Commercial intent keyword clustering, technical hygiene, and high-ROI monthly ranking sprints.
- [Performance Marketing Ads](https://theflexflow.in/performance-marketing): Direct-response Meta & Google ad funnels engineered for verified sub-₹60 CPL and direct CRM lead delivery.
- [Brand Identity & Systems](https://theflexflow.in/brand-identity): Type systems, color tokens, and asset component libraries that maintain visual authority everywhere.
- [Social Content Batch](https://theflexflow.in/social-media): 30-post batch content production aligned with founder positioning and organic reach.

## Case Studies & Verified Client Proof

- [Polynomial Protocol](https://theflexflow.in/work#polynomial): 4x protocol deposit growth in 60 days with sub-90s onboarding for gasless DeFi perpetuals on Ethereum L2.
- [Post Bridge](https://theflexflow.in/work#post-bridge): 3x free trial signups and +38% trial-to-paid conversion for social automation software.
- [SuperX](https://theflexflow.in/work#superx): Doubled demo and trial conversions with 250k+ launch impressions on X.
- [ABC Tile & Sanitaryware](https://theflexflow.in/work#abc-tile-ads): 268 verified dealer leads at ₹55.59 CPL from 52M+ impressions across North India.
- [Voyage India Travel](https://theflexflow.in/work#travel-agency-ads): 160+ holiday package booking inquiries at ₹14.54 CPL on a lean initial spend.
- [Zara Salon & Spa](https://theflexflow.in/work#salon-ads): 1.08M city impressions at ₹2.35 CPM and 28+ booking inquiries at ₹45.00 each.

## Operating Model

- Single Point of Contact: The person who scopes your brief is the senior engineer who designs and deploys it.
- Fixed-Scope Sprints: Deliverables completed in days and weeks, not open-ended retainer burn.
- Real Attribution: All campaigns tracked to cash return, closed deals, or direct booking conversions.
